reviews.title: Terrible selection of songs, voices aren't pleasant
reviews.body: Inane song choices, of all children songs in the world does it have to be boring ones like baby shark, counting potatoes, hot cross buns? 🤢 horrible. The singer's voices are quite poor as well, fairly unpleasant to listen to, unbearable on repeat. Worst Tonie ever.
reviews.author: Veronica

reviews.title: Lots of toddler fun
reviews.body: This immediately became top 2 for my 14-month-old. It’s tied only with the Ms. Rachel one. Great songs!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 23 July 2026
reviews.author: Kittenpants

reviews.title: We love this puppy!
reviews.body: This is one of my 2 year old’s favorite Tonies! The Playtime Puppy is just a classic. He’s well made and has a ton of loved children’s songs on him. He’s also super durable and doubles as a good toy.  We listen to him nearly daily. Highly recommend!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 22 May 2026
reviews.author: E&E0715

features: A select compilation of the most popular traditional children's songs for playtime!
Teaches children about spreading joy and laughter, singing and rhythm, curiosity and new experiences and strengthening the bonds of friendship.
Includes Playtime Puppy toy character with 34 songs and total run time of approximately 52 minutes. Recommended Age Range: 3+, Language: English.

Tracklist: Songs: The Wheels on the Bus, If You're Happy and You Know It, The Muffin Man, Jack Be Nimble, Itsy Bitsy Spider, Rain Rain Go Away, Baby Shark, Let's Get Ready / Getting Out The Door, Old MacDonald Had a Farm, Mary Had a Little Lamb and more.
Requires Toniebox Audio Player to play audio; sold separately.
